projects.name: TokenBroker
projects.creator: Jesse
projects.description: Prepaid OpenAI-compatible AI API gateway: one account and one key for hundreds of models, with a $15/month flat plan for unlimited usage (fair-use limits) or pay-as-you-go from a prepaid wallet. Also speaks Anthropic /v1/messages, so Claude Code works with environment variables only. Earn credits by running the worker app on idle hardware, including a phone worker.
features: One key for hundreds of models via an OpenAI-compatible API
$15/month flat plan or pay-as-you-go prepaid wallet
Earn credits by running the worker app on PC or phone

projects.name: Collectify
projects.creator: Montana Ross
projects.description: Free, offline, no-account TCG collection app: camera OCR card scanning, binders, price tracking, in-person trading, and a booster-pack mining game. Covers 54 games and 440,000+ cards with prices.

projects.name: Dead Grid
projects.creator: Jesse
projects.description: Open-beta zombie survival game whose map is the player's real US neighbourhood (OpenStreetMap, 2020 Census horde size). Scavenge and build by day, hold the wall at night; survivors need food, water, sleep, hygiene, and morale. Free, no ads, no account; Android 8.0+ and browser.
features: Map is the player's real US neighbourhood
Scavenge and build by day, defend the wall at night
Survivor needs: food, water, sleep, hygiene, morale
